Messages.Author: Hakuron
Messages.Body:
Cardtexts are required, as ALWAYS.

Name: Inscription
Cardtype: Equipment.
[tha] Put this equipment on a ready vampire and put a card that requires Blood Sorcery [tha] from your hand on it (face up, out of play; this acting vampire pays the cost of that card). The vampire with this equipment can burn this equipment to use the basic Blood Sorcery ability of that card.
[THA] As above, but the vampire can use the superior Blood Sorcery [THA] ability of the card.

Name: Drain Essence
Cardtype: Combat
Cost: 1 blood
Discipline: Thaumaturgy
Not usable on the first round of combat.
[tha] Strike: ranged; steal 2 blood.
[THA] Strike: ranged; steal 4 blood.
